info.title: quickbooks (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: QuickBooks Online Accounting API. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens. All entity URLs follow the pattern /v3/company/{companyId}/{entity}. Every update must supply the record's current SyncToken to prevent stale-write conflicts. Deletes are performed via POST with ?operation=delete. Queries use a structured syntax (resembling SQL) posted to /v3/company/{companyId}/query.

get.summary: Run a QuickBooks query supplied as a URL parameter. Supports SELECT * or COUNT(*), WHERE conditions joined by AND, LIKE
get.description: Run a QuickBooks query supplied as a URL parameter. Supports SELECT * or COUNT(*), WHERE conditions joined by AND, LIKE and IN filters, ORDERBY, and pagination with STARTPOSITION and MAXRESULTS.

200.description: {QueryResponse: {entity_type: [records], startPosition: int, maxResults: int, totalCount: int}}

post.summary: Run a QuickBooks query to find and filter entity records. Supports SELECT * or COUNT(*), WHERE conditions joined by AND,
post.description: Run a QuickBooks query to find and filter entity records. Supports SELECT * or COUNT(*), WHERE conditions joined by AND, LIKE and IN filters, ORDERBY, and pagination with STARTPOSITION and MAXRESULTS. OR, joins, and grouping are not supported.

200.description: {QueryResponse: {entity_type: [records], startPosition: int, maxResults: int, totalCount: int}}

requestBody.description: SQL-like query string (e.g., "SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE TotalAmt > '100.00' MAXRESULTS 25")

get.summary: Look up one customer record by ID, returning all of its fields.
get.description: Look up one customer record by ID, returning all of its fields.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the customer to retrieve.

post.description:
[quickbooks.customer.create] Add a new customer record. DisplayName must not duplicate any existing customer, vendor, or employee name.

[quickbooks.customer.update] Modify an existing customer. The request body must include Id and the current SyncToken. Supports sparse updates when sparse is set to true.

requestBody.description: Customer fields: {DisplayName (required), GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, CompanyName, Title, Suffix, PrintOnCheckName, Notes, Active, Taxable, Job, BillWithParent, PreferredDeliveryMethod, BillAddr, ShipAddr, PrimaryPhone, Mobile, Fax, PrimaryEmailAddr, WebAddr, DefaultTaxCodeRef, SalesTermRef, PaymentMethodRef, CurrencyRef, ParentRef}

get.description: Fetch a single vendor record by its unique identifier.

post.description:
[quickbooks.vendor.create] Register a new vendor. DisplayName must not duplicate any existing customer, vendor, or employee name.

[quickbooks.vendor.update] Update an existing vendor record. Must include Id and SyncToken in the request.

requestBody.description: Vendor fields: {DisplayName (required), GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, CompanyName, Suffix, PrintOnCheckName, Active, Vendor1099, BillRate, AcctNum, TaxIdentifier, BillAddr, PrimaryPhone, Mobile, Fax, PrimaryEmailAddr, WebAddr, TermRef, CurrencyRef}

get.summary: Fetch a single invoice including its line items, customer, and payment status.
get.description: Fetch a single invoice including its line items, customer, and payment status.

post.description:
[quickbooks.invoice.create] Generate a new invoice for a customer. At minimum, requires a customer reference and at least one line item.

[quickbooks.invoice.update] Update an existing invoice. Must include Id and SyncToken. Supports sparse updates.

[quickbooks.invoice.delete] Permanently remove an invoice. The request must include the Id and SyncToken, and the operation=delete query parameter.

[quickbooks.invoice.void] Void an invoice, zeroing out its balance while preserving the record for audit purposes. Include Id, SyncToken, and set void to true in the query.

requestBody.description: Invoice fields: {CustomerRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required - [{DetailType: 'SalesItemLineDetail', Amount, SalesItemLineDetail: {ItemRef: {value: id}, UnitPrice, Qty}}]), DocNumber, TxnDate, DueDate, PrivateNote, CustomerMemo, BillAddr, ShipAddr, BillEmail, SalesTermRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, Deposit, ShipDate, TrackingNum, ApplyTaxAfterDiscount, TxnTaxDetail}

post.summary: Email an invoice to the customer. Uses the BillEmail address on the invoice unless overridden via query parameter.
post.description: Email an invoice to the customer. Uses the BillEmail address on the invoice unless overridden via query parameter.

parameters.name: sendTo
parameters.description: Override email address to send the invoice to.

Ref.description: A lightweight reference linking to another entity. Contains the target record's ID and optionally its display name.

value.description: Unique identifier of the referenced entity.

name.description: Human-readable name of the referenced entity.

Address.description: A structured postal address used across billing, shipping, and mailing contexts.

CountrySubDivisionCode.description: State or province code (e.g., CA, ON).

PhoneNumber.description: A phone number stored as free-form text.

MetaData.description: System-managed timestamps tracking when a record was first created and most recently modified.

CreateTime.description: Timestamp when the record was initially created.

LastUpdatedTime.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification.

LinkedTxn.description: A reference that connects one transaction to another (e.g., linking a payment to an invoice).

TxnType.description: Entity type of the linked transaction (e.g., Invoice, Payment, Bill).

SalesItemLineDetail.description: Detail fields for a line item representing a product or service sold.

ItemRef.description: Reference to the item (product or service) being sold.

UnitPrice.description: Price per unit of the item.

TaxCodeRef.description: Tax code applied to this line.

DiscountAmt.description: Flat discount amount on this line.

ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail.description: Detail fields for an expense line tied to a specific item (product or service purchased).

BillableStatus.description: Whether this expense can be billed to a customer.

AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.description: Detail fields for an expense line referencing a ledger account directly rather than an item.

TxnTaxDetail.description: Tax calculation details for a transaction, including individual tax line breakdowns.

TotalTax.description: Sum of all tax amounts on the transaction.

Customer.description: A buyer -- either an individual or a business -- that you invoice or sell to. To remove from active use, set Active to false rather than deleting.

Id.description: System-assigned unique identifier for this customer.

SyncToken.description: Concurrency guard for this record. Supply the current value when sending updates to avoid overwriting concurrent changes.

DisplayName.description: The name shown in dropdowns and printed on transaction forms. Must be distinct from every other customer, vendor, and employee display name.

CompanyName.description: Business name associated with this customer.

PrintOnCheckName.description: Name to print on checks issued to this customer.

Active.description: Whether this customer is active. Defaults to true.

Taxable.description: Whether transactions for this customer are taxable.

Job.description: Whether this entry represents a job (sub-customer).

Balance.description: What this customer currently owes. Calculated automatically; cannot be set directly.

BalanceWithJobs.description: Combined open balance across this customer and its child jobs. Calculated automatically.

PreferredDeliveryMethod.description: How the customer prefers to receive communications.

PrimaryEmailAddr.description: Primary email address for this customer.

DefaultTaxCodeRef.description: Tax code used automatically on new transactions involving this customer.

SalesTermRef.description: Default payment terms for sales to this customer.

CurrencyRef.description: Currency used for this customer's transactions.

FullyQualifiedName.description: Hierarchical name including parent names. Read-only.

Vendor.description: A company or individual you pay for supplies, inventory, or contracted work. Deactivate by setting Active to false instead of deleting.

SyncToken.description: Concurrency guard. Must match the server's current value on updates.

DisplayName.description: Name shown in lists and on transactions. Must be unique.

Active.description: Whether this vendor is active. Defaults to true.

Vendor1099.description: Whether this vendor receives a 1099 tax form.

Balance.description: Amount owed to this vendor. Read-only.

BillRate.description: Default billing rate for this vendor.

AcctNum.description: Vendor's account number in your records.

TaxIdentifier.description: Tax ID or SSN for this vendor.

TermRef.description: Default payment terms for bills from this vendor.

Account.description: A bookkeeping category that groups related transactions (e.g., revenue, overhead, bank balances, amounts owed). Deactivate by setting Active to false.

Name.description: Display name of the account. Must be unique.

AccountType.description: Broad category for the account -- determines where it sits on financial statements. Examples: Bank, Expense, Income, Equity, Fixed Asset, Credit Card.

AccountSubType.description: Further refinement of the account type (e.g., Checking, Savings, AdvertisingPromotional, OfficeExpenses).

Active.description: Whether this account is active. Defaults to true.

Classification.description: High-level grouping: Asset, Equity, Expense, Liability, or Revenue. Read-only.

SubAccount.description: Whether this is a sub-account of another account.

ParentRef.description: Reference to the parent account when SubAccount is true.

CurrentBalance.description: Current balance of this account. Read-only.

Invoice.description: A bill sent to a customer listing what they owe. Holds line items, amounts, and the running balance after any payments are applied.

DueDate.description: Deadline for the customer to remit payment.

CustomerRef.description: Which customer this invoice is for. Must be provided when creating.

Line.description: Invoice line items. Each line specifies an amount, detail type, and type-specific fields.

TotalAmt.description: Calculated total for the invoice. Read-only.

Balance.description: Remaining amount due after payments. Read-only.

PrivateNote.description: Internal memo not visible to the customer.

CustomerMemo.description: A message displayed to the customer on the invoice.

Item.description: Something your business sells or buys -- a physical product, a billable service, or a non-stocked part. Appears as a line on sales and purchasing documents.

Name.description: Display name of the item. Must be unique.

Description.description: Sales-facing description shown on invoices and receipts.

PurchaseCost.description: Default cost when purchasing this item.

QtyOnHand.description: Current stock level. Only applicable to inventory items.

TrackQtyOnHand.description: Whether inventory tracking is enabled for this item.

IncomeAccountRef.description: Account where revenue from sales of this item is recorded.

ExpenseAccountRef.description: Account where costs of purchasing this item are recorded.

AssetAccountRef.description: Inventory asset account. Required for inventory-type items.

FullyQualifiedName.description: Hierarchical name including parent items. Read-only.

Level.description: Depth in the item hierarchy. Read-only.

Payment.description: Records money received from a customer and links it to one or more outstanding invoices, lowering each invoice's remaining balance.

CustomerRef.description: The customer who made the payment. Required.

TotalAmt.description: Total amount of the payment. Required.

PaymentRefNum.description: Check number or other reference identifier.

UnappliedAmt.description: Portion of the payment not yet applied to invoices. Read-only.

Line.description: Lines indicating which invoices this payment is applied to.

DepositToAccountRef.description: Account where the payment funds are deposited.

Bill.description: A vendor invoice recording an amount you owe for received supplies, stock, or completed contract work. Paid down via BillPayment transactions.

VendorRef.description: The vendor who issued the bill. Required.

Line.description: Expense or item-based line items. Required.

APAccountRef.description: Accounts payable account for this bill.

Estimate.description: A price proposal presented to a customer before any sale is final. Once approved, it can be turned into a billable invoice.

CustomerRef.description: The customer receiving the estimate. Required.

Line.description: Line items included in the estimate. Required.

TxnStatus.description: Current approval status of the estimate.

ExpirationDate.description: Date after which the estimate is no longer valid.

Purchase.description: A financial transaction representing an expenditure made via cash, check, or credit card. Tracks the payment method and account used.

AccountRef.description: The bank or credit card account used. Required.

PaymentType.description: How the purchase was paid. Required.

Line.description: Expense or item-based line items. Required.

Credit.description: Whether this is a refund/credit transaction.

EntityRef.description: Vendor or employee associated with this purchase.

BillPayment.description: Records a check or credit-card payment sent to a vendor to settle one or more open bills.

PayType.description: Method used to pay the vendor. Required.

Line.description: Lines linking this payment to specific bills.

CheckPayment.description: Check-specific fields when PayType is Check.

CreditCardPayment.description: Credit card details when PayType is CreditCard.

CreditMemo.description: A credit issued to a customer that lowers their outstanding amount. May offset open invoices or be returned as a refund.

RemainingCredit.description: Credit amount not yet applied. Read-only.

SalesReceipt.description: A single document recording both a sale and its collection simultaneously, used when the buyer settles the amount on the spot.

PurchaseOrder.description: A document sent to a vendor requesting goods or services at specified prices and quantities.

POStatus.description: Current status of the purchase order.

VendorCredit.description: A credit received from a vendor, reducing the amount owed on future bills.

JournalEntry.description: A manual accounting entry with debit and credit lines that must balance. Used for adjustments, reclassifications, and other non-standard transactions.

Line.description: Debit and credit lines. The sum of debits must equal the sum of credits.

Adjustment.description: Whether this entry is an adjustment to the books.

Deposit.description: A record of funds deposited into a bank account, potentially combining multiple payment sources.

DepositToAccountRef.description: The bank account receiving the deposit. Required.

Transfer.description: A movement of funds between two accounts within the same company.

FromAccountRef.description: The account money is moving out of. Required.

ToAccountRef.description: The account money is moving into. Required.

Employee.description: A person who works for the company. Used for payroll, time tracking, and expense allocation.

SSN.description: Social Security Number. Write-only for security.

Department.description: An organizational unit used to classify transactions for tracking and reporting purposes.

Term.description: Payment terms that define when invoices are due and any early-payment discounts offered.

Name.description: Display name (e.g., Net 30, Due on receipt).

DueDays.description: Number of days after the transaction date when payment is due.

DiscountDays.description: Number of days within which the discount applies.

PaymentMethod.description: A named method by which customers can pay (e.g., Cash, Check, Visa, MasterCard).

TaxCode.description: A tax configuration that determines which tax rates apply to a transaction. Read-only via the API.

Taxable.description: Whether transactions using this code are subject to tax.

TaxGroup.description: Whether this is a group of multiple tax rates.

SalesTaxRateList.description: Tax rates applied to sales transactions.

PurchaseTaxRateList.description: Tax rates applied to purchase transactions.

TaxRate.description: An individual tax rate that can be part of a tax code. Read-only via the API.

AgencyRef.description: Tax agency that collects this tax.

TimeActivity.description: A timesheet record capturing labor performed by a team member or outside contractor, which may be charged to a client project.

NameOf.description: Whether the person is an employee or vendor.

RefundReceipt.description: A transaction recording a refund given to a customer, including the items returned and the refund method.

Attachable.description: A file or note attached to one or more transactions or entities.

AttachableRef.description: Entities this file is linked to.
